pr.body:
Closes #95.

Scientists can browse and select every displayed protein chain below the 3D canvas while keeping Inspector tools and Properties / History / Jobs available. The redundant Inspector Sequence tab is removed. The approved implementation contract is [docs/plans/issue-95-workspace-sequence-viewer.md](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/blob/5dd584a7e32e6bffaa1fdba80c0002a1b354b959/docs/plans/issue-95-workspace-sequence-viewer.md).

### Implemented outcome and checkpoints

- C1 extracts indexed, typed protein sequence presentation with source order, numbering/insertion codes, nonstandard identities, complete canonical residue membership and shared selection requests.
- C2 docks vertically stacked chain rows with independent horizontal scrolling, bounded two-axis virtualization, collapse/hide/toolbar restore and a safe browser preference. Display follows application visibility/representations/isolation; a partly displayed chain retains its complete observed sequence and visible surfaces retain source-chain context.
- Keyboard arrows, Home/End and Enter/Space, full/mixed coverage and shared fixed-anchor modifier behavior remain independent of picking mode. Selection and presentation preserve camera, molecular visibility and canonical state. Transient focus/scroll survive owned responsive remounts and reset across projects.
- C3 corrects outside-focus reclamation, final-chain focus fallback and cached-project viewport boundaries, with fail-first regressions. Existing native selection journeys and workflow-surface accessibility tests now navigate to the replacement UI without weakening their assertions.

D-146 records derived sequence ownership and explicitly supersedes the temporary Inspector/nonprotein presentation in D-145. Normalized application data, canonical selection and existing artifact/visit guards remain authoritative; there is no duplicate molecular store or renderer-owned membership.

### Approved scope decisions

- **Simplified/rejected as proposed:** an active-chain selector becomes all displayed chains together, following explicit user guidance. The replacement is protein-only; other molecular access remains in Components and existing tools.
- **Optional and omitted:** selection-driven automatic scrolling. Keyboard navigation reveals its focus; ordinary selection preserves manual browsing.
- **Outside scope:** alignment, missing-residue reconstruction, secondary-structure annotation, sequence editing/export, nonprotein sequence browsing and a height resize handle. Missing positions are never fabricated. No essential approved outcome is deferred and no new follow-up issue is needed.
- Existing tiny synthetic native-picking targets use the existing camera zoom control to fit the shorter canvas. Original fixtures, picking/membership/camera assertions, performance limits, dependencies and scientific settings remain unchanged. The pre-existing protein canvas check waits for asynchronous redraw using its identical pixel condition and existing five-second timeout. Failed and interrupted attempts are retained as diagnostics.

### Compatibility, science and release

Stable minor **0.25.0 → 0.26.0** adds an independently accessible workspace capability; a patch understates it. No public API or durable-data break requires a major increment, and established stable qualification makes a prerelease unnecessary. All five authoritative versions agree: web package, Python project, root uv.lock package, FastAPI metadata and archive application version.

No dependency upgrade, HTTP/job/plugin contract change, molecular-model change or new migration. Alembic stays **0014**; project/viewer/archive schemas stay **2**, normalized/selection/component schemas **1**. Actual tagged v0.25.0 and final v0.26.0 producer/reader processes pass in both directions, preserving originals, all conformers, selections/scenes/surfaces/jobs, exact history and archive remapping. Portable archives retain current state, not Undo history. Sequence scroll/focus/anchors remain transient; only optional presentation preferences enter browser storage. Rollback uses a matching v0.25.0 client/API and retained complete managed data, without a schema downgrade.

Observed sequence context is not full biological sequence, alignment, preparation or proof of chemical validity. Unknown/nonstandard identities remain identifiable; classification, connectivity and native scientific limitations remain documented.

### Verification and review

Clean fixed candidate **80720fee873b321b950db84a52df8bd3c3926f82** passes the complete **20-command** recipe: **1,250 Python, 370 frontend, 8 supervisor and 343 browser tests**, with **61 unchanged preceding-release exclusions**, zero failures/flakes/retries/Python or required native scientific skips. Frozen installs, fresh migration, Ruff/mypy/ESLint/TypeScript, build, actual tagged readers and version/dependency/production-harness audits pass. All **583** source/test/tool/script/lock identities and lossless log hashes verify; source digest **56b62d3de68322e9afb8dafe856fb31d2cd8dc88bb98464a6cc4658d2b72702b**.

- [Exact commands/environment and step/log hashes](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/blob/5dd584a7e32e6bffaa1fdba80c0002a1b354b959/docs/assets/workspace-sequence-viewer/c3-candidate4-gate.json)
- [Counts, unchanged exclusion set and performance evidence](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/blob/5dd584a7e32e6bffaa1fdba80c0002a1b354b959/docs/assets/workspace-sequence-viewer/c3-candidate4-summary.json)
- [Actual preceding-reader results](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/blob/5dd584a7e32e6bffaa1fdba80c0002a1b354b959/docs/assets/workspace-sequence-viewer/c3-candidate4-forward-read.json) and [reverse direction](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/blob/5dd584a7e32e6bffaa1fdba80c0002a1b354b959/docs/assets/workspace-sequence-viewer/c3-candidate4-reverse-read.json)
- [Complete-diff implementer self-review and resolved findings](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/blob/5dd584a7e32e6bffaa1fdba80c0002a1b354b959/docs/assets/workspace-sequence-viewer/c3-full-diff-review.md), [verification](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/blob/5dd584a7e32e6bffaa1fdba80c0002a1b354b959/docs/VERIFICATION.md), [sequence guidance](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/blob/5dd584a7e32e6bffaa1fdba80c0002a1b354b959/docs/SEQUENCE_VIEWER.md), [release notes](https://github.com/ManuelSe/Neistra/blob/5dd584a7e32e6bffaa1fdba80c0002a1b354b959/docs/RELEASE_NOTES.md)

Both themes, desktop/mobile, 320px, actual 100%/200% browser zoom, scoped axe, native gestures, shared ranges, visibility/isolation/Undo, scroll/focus/remount and renderer/project/camera/request invariants pass. The visible 10,000-residue/30,000-atom profile is qualified with the property table unmounted; the many-chain stack stays bounded. All existing native/scientific budgets remain unchanged. This is pinned-host regression evidence, not a cross-browser or chemistry-throughput claim.

Review is implementer self-review unless a GitHub review is actually returned. Request `@codex review`; address actionable findings and satisfy current checks, required reviews and conversations without override. Preserve checkpoint history with a **normal merge commit**. After merge, repeat the complete gate and both actual-reader directions on the exact merged `master` SHA before creating annotated **v0.26.0** and the stable GitHub release. Publish the scope/evidence close-out, record publication through a documentation audit PR, and clean the branch only after remote receipts are verified.
